points: Moved static asset generation to the client so assets are produced on demand, removing server-side inference and the related storage cost.
Built an internal static code-generation pipeline for the asset workflow. Reviewed 118 API endpoints and helped resolve the issues found.
Configured containerized Supabase services for offline deployment and built a sync engine to reconcile event data between offline and online states.

items.title: Cloud Workspace
items.desc: Collaborative cloud workspace with real-time messaging, shared tasks, file/image uploads, scheduled meetings, and peer-to-peer video calls. Chat runs on WebSockets with Cloudflare Durable Objects for stateful coordination; role-based access via Better Auth.

items.title: Local AI Assistant
items.desc: Privacy-first chat interface for locally hosted Ollama models. Streams responses, discovers installed models automatically, and keeps chat history in the browser.

items.title: goshell
items.desc: Minimal shell in Go built with the standard library. Runs external programs and multi-stage pipelines with os.Pipe, and includes cd, exit, and history built-ins with !! and !n re-execution.

research.title: Research
research.body: Analyzed the real production codebase behind react.dev to map architecture decisions: custom MDX components, a build-time SSG pipeline, and the React Compiler already running in production.
points: No state management library needed — URL + useState + Context sufficient
50+ custom MDX components behind each doc page
Custom SSG pipeline that serializes React tree to JSON at build time
Build-time eval() workarounds acknowledged as intentional hacks
